quotes.name: Melton Neilon
quotes.quote: I heard about that apprenticeship program—sounds like a solid way to get kids learning real skills instead of just sitting in classrooms. The Tribune should ask how many of those apprentices actually stick with it and land jobs afterward, because that’s what really matters.

quotes.name: Elio Perez
quotes.quote: I heard about that apprenticeship thing—sounds like a real chance for kids who don't see a path after school. The Tribune should ask how many of those spots are actually going to West Oakland kids, 'cause we always get left out.

quotes.name: Depak Ying
quotes.quote: I heard about that program—sounds like a good start, but the Tribune should ask how they're making sure kids from all over Oakland, not just the easy-to-reach neighborhoods, get a fair shot at those apprenticeships.
